nodes.summary: Asano's contraction lemma: the Asano contraction of a multi-affine polydisc-stable polynomial is polydisc stable (Asano, Phys. Rev. Lett. 24 (1970)).
nodes.title: Asano's contraction lemma

nodes.summary: The Asano contraction of the variables `i` and `j`: for `p = A + B z_i + C z_j + D z_i z_j` it is `A + D z_i`, computed from the values of `p` at `z_i, z_j ∈ {0, 1}`.
nodes.title: Asano contraction of two variables

nodes.summary: Asano's lemma in one variable: if `A + E t + D t²` has no zero in the open unit disk, then neither has `A + D t`.
nodes.title: Asano's lemma in one variable

nodes.summary: For the Ising model on a finite graph with uniform ferromagnetic coupling and `β ≥ 0`, every complex zero of the partition function in the fugacity `z = e^{-2βh}` lies on the unit circle (Lee and Yang, *Statistical theory of equations of state and phase transitions. II*, Phys. Rev. 87 (1952)).
nodes.title: Lee–Yang circle theorem

nodes.summary: A function of finitely many complex variables is multi-affine if it is affine in each variable separately.
nodes.title: Multi-affine function of several complex variables

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
